brief: Prioritise vegetation clearance over other remedial activity for Camden Works 230/34kV to ensure unobstructed airflow to radiator banks and ventilation openings [SOP-011]. Because this ageing unit cannot be attended in time or has a reduced margin against mechanical failure, apply the loading restriction in [MG-021] in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period [MG-021].
